label: Geralt
description: Gruff, deadpan, and expecting to be paid for this.
direction: Speak low, dry and gravelly in a flat near-monotone: world-weary, unimpressed, economical. The humour is all deadpan. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The game register of Geralt: hmm, the weather, Roach, and coin. His usual swearing is left out entirely. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: The Witcher (stories by Andrzej Sapkowski; games by CD Projekt Red)
rights.author: Andrzej Sapkowski (character); CD Projekt Red (the games this register comes from)
rights.pd_basis: None. Geralt first appeared in Andrzej Sapkowski's 1986 short story; Sapkowski is living and the stories are in copyright. CD Projekt holds rights in the games. Doug Cockle voices Geralt in the English-language games and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Doug Cockle's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Looks like rain.
lines.start_drive_2: Come on, Roach. We've got a contract.
lines.start_drive_3: Looks like rain. Good day for a drive.
lines.start_drive_4: Witcher for hire. Navigation included. Coin up front.
lines.start_drive_6: Got a long road ahead. No time for Gwent.
lines.start_drive_8: I've tracked griffins. I can find your destination.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Hmm. Roach does this too.
lines.arrived: We're here. Contract's done. Now, about my coin.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Place of power, gotta be.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Great. Just great.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Worse than a nest of drowners.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Tracks everywhere. Not a monster, though.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. Medallion's humming. Careful.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Slow down. I'm not paying that toll.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop. Hmm.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. City guard. Keep your head down.
lines.reroute_chime: Missed it. Great. Finding another trail.
